title: Vision Component Visual State v1
description: Per-component visual identity, sourced from the explicit Atlas-to-Vision manifest fields (see docs/bible/10-vision/223-atlas-to-vision-contract.md), never inferred from render order.

name.description: e.g. "band", "stone_reference" — the real component key, identical to the backend's.

geometryRole.description: CURRENT mapping: band/prongs/basket_support -> production_metal; stone_reference -> stone_reference. Matches specs/atlas/v1/geometry-component.schema.json's enum exactly — this is the same vocabulary, now also surfaced to Vision.

visible.description: Vision-only state (useVisionStore.componentVisibility) — never affects STEP/STL export inclusion.

generationStatus.description: CURRENT: mapped from the backend's has_geometry check to SUCCEEDED or EMPTY only; SUCCEEDED_WITH_FALLBACK/FAILED are not currently distinguished at the component level.
